description: Hook configuration for ephemeral artifact capture system. Add to .claude/settings.json under 'hooks' and 'cron' keys.

pre-submit.description: Capture user prompt and system context before API submission
notes: Fires BEFORE Claude API call
Captures: user message + system context (first 500 chars)
Returns immediately; queues to buffer

post-submit.description: Capture full Claude API response after submission
notes: Fires AFTER Claude returns response
Captures: full response object, response text, token counts
Includes prompt hash for lineage

post-tool-call.description: Capture tool outputs (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, etc)
notes: Fires after each tool invocation (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Bash, etc)
Captures: tool name, command, stdout (2KB), stderr (1KB), exit code, elapsed_ms
STREAMING FORMAT: one JSON per line (JSONL)

post-error.description: Capture exceptions and errors for debugging
notes: Fires when exception or error is caught
Captures: error type, message, stack trace (2KB), context (last tool/command)
Non-blocking even on error

session-init.description: Capture session metadata when session starts or resumes
notes: Fires at session start + on resume
Captures: session_id, task_id, investigation_label, cwd, environment snapshot
Metadata written immediately to disk (not buffered)

ephemeral-rotate-archive.description: Archive and compress ephemeral artifacts older than 7 days
notes: Runs daily at 22:00 UTC
Archives forensics/ephemeral/{YYYY-MM-DD}/ folders >7 days old
Compresses to forensics/ephemeral/archive/ephemeral-{YYYY-MM-DD}.tar.gz
Writes COC entry for each archive
TODO: Upload to S3/B2 WORM bucket if configured
Deletes source folder after archival

async_guarantee: All hooks marked 'async: true' to prevent main thread blocking
Hook scripts return immediately after queuing (<100ms)
Background flusher subprocess handles I/O (main doesn't wait)
Subprocess spawned with run_in_background, parent detaches
buffer_strategy: In-memory buffer per artifact_type (transcript, response, bash-output, error, cot, prompt, metadata)
If threshold exceeded, immediate flush to disk (non-blocking subprocess)
Flusher daemon wakes every 5 seconds to flush pending records
forensic_integrity: All artifacts stored in forensics/ (system of record)
Complete lineage in filename (task_id, session_id, timestamp)
COC entry written for each artifact (SHA256 hash, metadata)
Court-ready: complete audit trail recoverable via 6x_forensic_recovery.py
zero_context_burden: Hooks return in <100ms (queue + return, no wait)
I/O happens in subprocess, not main thread
Buffer size capped to prevent OOM
Flusher runs detached; main never monitors it
configuration_steps: 3. Set EPHEMERAL_ROOT env var in hook config (or use default)
4. Start flusher daemon on session init: python3 8x_ephemeral_capture.py flusher --pidfile /tmp/ephemeral-flusher.pid &
5. Verify: ls forensics/ephemeral/ after first session (should see transcript/, response/, etc folders)
6. Test: check transcript for user prompts, response for API returns, bash-output for tool invocations
